svg.title: Field lines and equipotentials of two equal and opposite charges
svg.desc: A negative charge on the left and an equal positive charge on the right. Computed field lines, in blue, leave the positive charge and curve around to end on the negative charge; the outermost ones loop wide or leave the picture. Computed green equipotentials are closed loops around each charge, nearly circular close to it and flattened toward the middle, plus a straight zero-potential line midway between the charges. The equipotentials cross the field lines at right angles. The potential is most positive near the positive charge and most negative near the negative charge.
